title: Caught in the Rain
text:
The sky turned a heavy grey just as the school bell rang. Within minutes, rain was falling so hard that the drain outside the gate began to gurgle and swell.
Ravi had forgotten his umbrella again. He stood under the shelter, watching his classmates splash towards the carpark, and wondered how long he would be stuck there.
Then a small blue umbrella appeared beside him. It belonged to Wei Ming, the quiet boy who sat at the back of the class. "We can share," he said simply. They walked home together, shoulders wet, laughing at every puddle. Ravi never forgot that umbrella, or the friend who held it.
